source_snapshot.test_name_items: Server Mgmt View System Event Log
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

The agent cannot press keys in the pre-OS BIOS setup UI or observe the saved/reloaded screen over SSH; a person must navigate Setup and reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; follows a generated settings lifecycle even though the item explicitly requests viewing the System Event Log.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; correctly treats View and arbitrary change/default operations as incompatible scopes and preserves existing log evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify that the Server Mgmt firmware UI can display the intended System Event Log records, fields, ordering and navigation, but the current Procedure instead tests unspecified settings persistence and default restoration.
original_method: The row tells the operator to mutate random values, save/reboot and load defaults despite naming a read-only viewer, and it supplies no controlled event, expected record schema, pagination requirement or authoritative-store correlation.
manual_activity: After correction to a view test, a human must navigate the pre-OS viewer and inspect record content, sequence and presentation. If a settings test is intended instead, it must identify separate writable fields; the current mixed workflow cannot be performed.
required_inputs: Owner choice of read-only viewer versus configuration lifecycle
Mapping between BIOS Server Mgmt viewer and authoritative BMC/System Event Log store
Benign controlled event with expected source/type/severity/time fields
Expected ordering, pagination, filtering and empty/full behavior
Immutable archives, console/OOB and final-state expectation
safety_requirements: Do not clear the System Event Log named as the object to view.
Do not change all/random or invoke Load Default to prove viewer behavior.
Archive authoritative records before any later approved event or setting action.
Do not accept external SEL output as proof of firmware UI rendering/navigation, or firmware screenshots as full proof of authoritative-store completeness.
Stop on unexpected log loss, wrong-store evidence or management failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BMC/System Event Log exports, clocks, event identifiers and management health.
After correction, correlate authoritative records with operator UI captures and flag truncation/order/field mismatches.
Do not drive the BIOS viewer, clear logs, change configuration or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve and align the source scope.
For viewer scope, create/identify the approved event and inspect every required UI field/navigation behavior; for settings scope, define a separate bounded plan.
Evaluate scope-matched evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Manual pre-OS access is correctly recognized, but its claimed setting changes are not applicable to a View function. No source command exists.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only event export only for record correlation after scope correction; it cannot replace on-screen viewer validation and no clear/default command is permitted.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The null script and 5/20-minute fields are recorded. The generic change/save/default sequence remains preserved as the conflicting source and is not executable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For a view test, seed or select a traceable benign event, record the authoritative store, then verify firmware UI type/severity/source/timestamp/order, navigation, pagination and truncation without mutation. Move policy/default coverage to a distinct settings case.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC revision and viewer/store implementation after owner confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, event generator and read-only export-client versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Server Mgmt System Event Log viewer and BMC event schema documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unrelated persistence/default actions with actual viewer behavior.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores the named UI-view coverage; configuration persistence is excluded unless separately defined.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Scope decision, store mapping, event and UI acceptance model.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only APIs may expose more fields than the constrained firmware UI; each evidence source must be labeled.

project_override_considerations: A project can select a representative event set and viewer navigation depth, but cannot count settings/default evidence as fulfillment of the View case. Exclusions must be explicit.
expected_evidence: Platform/store identity, log archive and controlled-event provenance
Viewer screenshots covering expected fields, ordering, navigation and pagination
Correlated authoritative event records and management health
Final unchanged/approved state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item explicitly requires View System Event Log, while Procedure/Criteria require changing a value, persisting it and restoring defaults. Those actions and evidence do not test the named viewer behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only viewer validation and settings persistence are different core operations. Selecting either without owner correction would alter intended coverage and could erase evidence, so execution is genuinely blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the human UI boundary but rejects its generic mutation plan.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with BLOCKED and adds explicit viewer schema/navigation and authoritative-store correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes this Server Mgmt viewer case distinct from adjacent log-policy cases and records the exact scope correction needed.

review_improvement: Defines concrete viewer acceptance—record fields, ordering and navigation—while preventing destruction of the same event evidence the case is meant to inspect.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source contains an explicit semantic collision, not merely missing parameters. The provided lifecycle cannot validate a read-only viewer, so BLOCKED and SOURCE_CONFLICT are required until the owner aligns the row.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat event generation, viewer navigation, log operations, setting changes or reboots; preserve the first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
